messages:
nina (infra): Observability alerted: p50 +1.7ms on single-token chat after last kernel-ranking roll. Spike at ~04:20 UTC.

kevin (runtime): I can repro. Flamegraph points to host_tokenize and kernel_select slowpath. Trace: https://perf.redwood/3344455555

jena (perf): Sampling summary: host_tokenizer::tokenize +36%, http2::frame_coalesce +20%, kernel_selector::evaluate +10%, kvcache::lookup_miss +7%.

omar (backend): We added a per-request packing hint into KernelKey to prefer certain kernels for short sequences. That hint is being generated with per-request entropy to improve packing.

nina (infra): If hint isn't stable it will fragment kvcache keys and raise miss rate. Matches the kv miss bump.

kevin (runtime): I'll roll back the hint from the kv key for seqlen<=8 and replace with a stable enum if we need kernel guidance. Opening rollback PR.

sam (sre): Repro script I ran: for i in 1..800 in parallel curl tiny requests; p50/p95 increased consistently. Setting temp alert: tiny-chat.p50 > 10ms -> page.

jena (perf): Local canary diff: removing hint from key reduces miss-rate from ~11% to ~3% and recovers ~1.5ms p50. Will add microbench for 1-token flows and kvcache key stability test.

omar (backend): Also the http2 coalescer now waits up to 700us to batch frames. That helps throughput but adds tail to tiny streams. I'll add a short-stream bypass header X-Short-Stream to skip coalescing when expected length <= 6.

kevin (runtime): Plan: rollback kv key change (kevin), add deterministic enum fallback, add kvcache key unit test (jena), and integrate X-Short-Stream with coalescer bypass (omar).

nina (infra): Filing INC-2042 and assigning kevin/jena/omar. Keep this thread for perf diffs and flamegraphs.

sam (sre): Canary rolling. I'll watch alerts and auto-rollback policy.

kevin (runtime): PRs: #4880 (kvkey rollback) and #4881 (deterministic enum). Linking CI when green.

jena (perf): Will post before/after flamegraphs once rollback is live.

omar (backend): Prototype for header landed in ingress branch, default false so no regression for long flows.

nina (infra): Thanks team.
